en.topic_title: Speaking record does not fully reflect lawmakers’ work, Hong Kong legislature president writes in op-ed rebuttal
en.topic_summary:
A lawmaker’s speaking record does not reflect the entirety of their work, the president of Hong Kong’s “patriots-only” legislature has written in response to a media report that found some members had never spoken at certain committee meetings.
